chemistry.notes: Estimated: Lucid's battery data page lists its Air packs (MY26+) as nickel-rich NMC; no Gravity page names its chemistry; same maker and 2170-class cells assumed.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs rates the Touring pack at 700V+ (above 600 V, the 800 V class); Grand Touring is 926 V (Wards).

preconditioning.notes: Lucid: Smart Preconditioning (automatic when routing to a fast charger) and a manual Precondition Battery button.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Wards and InsideEVs: Touring battery sized at 89 kWh (usable/gross not stated; bare capacity recorded as gross).

ac_max_kw.notes: Lucid: AC up to 19.2 kW (80 A).

dc_max_kw.notes: Wards: maximum DC fast-charge rate 300 kW; InsideEVs: up to 300 kW on 1,000 V stalls, 225 kW on 500 V Superchargers.
